english.note: This is the all-purpose way to refer to the person currently holding an office or title, such as 現任議員 or 現任校長.

examples.english: The incumbent legislator for that district says they will continue serving local residents.
examples.traditional: 嗰區嘅現任議員話會繼續為街坊服務。
